title: Substudy to Evaluate the Potential Treatment Effect of the ABBV-466 (risankizumab/trosunilimab) Combination Compared to Each Respective Monotherapy in Subjects with Moderately to Severely Active Crohn’s Disease or Ulcerative Colitis
official: A Phase 2 Platform Basket Study Evaluating Advanced Therapies in Subjects with Moderately to Severely Active Crohn’s Disease or Ulcerative Colitis
summary: Main objective: Substudy 1: To evaluate efficacy and safety of the ABBV-466 (risankizumab/trosunilimab) combination compared to the respective monotherapy component in adult subjects with moderately to severely active CD or UC.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Crohn's Disease specific: Crohn's Disease Activity Index (CDAI) score of ≥ 220
2. 2. Crohn's Disease specific: Confirmed diagnosis of CD at least 90 days prior to Baseline
3. 3. Crohn's Disease specific: Endoscopic evidence of mucosal inflammation as documented by an Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) of ≥ 6 for ileocolonic or colonic disease or SES-CD of ≥ 4 for isolated ileal disease.
4. 4. Crohn's Disease specific: Demonstrated failure of 1 or more therapy for CD
5. 5. Ulcerative Colitis specific: Confirmed diagnosis of UC at least 90 days prior to Baseline
6. 6. Ulcerative Colitis specific: Active UC with a modified Mayo Score (mMS) of 5 to 9 points and endoscopic subscore (ESS) of 2 to 3
7. 7. Ulcerative Colitis specific: Demonstrated failure of 1 or more therapy for UC
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Participants with demonstrated intolerance to p19 IL-23 inhibitors (including risankizumab)
2. 2. Participants treated with any investigational drug within 30 days or 5 halflives of the study treatments (whichever is longer) prior to the first dose of study treatment
3. 3. Participants who received any ATs (biologic or small molecules) prior to first dose of study treatment within the protocol specified time frame
4. 4. Participants with surgical bowel resection within the past 3 months prior to Baseline
5. 5. Crohn's Disease specific: Participants with >3 prior bowel resections
6. 6. Crohn's Disease specific: Participants with previous small bowel resection(s) of combined length >100 cm
7. 7. Ulcerative Colitis specific: Participants with prior colectomy (total or subtotal)
8. 8. Ulcerative Colitis specific: Participants with extent of disease limited to < 10 cm of rectum
